meta.title: Central product transaction database
meta.method: Public company releases and SEC filings. Each product transaction is stored once, then viewed as either an all-stage structure benchmark or a candidate-company precedent. Guaranteed consideration is separated from contingent milestones, royalties, profit shares and operating commitments. Undisclosed terms remain explicitly undisclosed.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive global rights; Oscotec may retain South Korea after Phase 3 results
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $140m U.S./EU development and regulatory milestones plus undisclosed commercial milestones
deals.royalty: High-single-digit to mid-teen royalties on net sales
deals.economics: Buyer received rights across indications; seller preserved a potential home-territory option.
deals.insight: A current benchmark for adding a late-stage oral specialty asset to an established rare-hematology commercial platform.

deals.stage: Marketed ex-U.S.; U.S. BLA under review
deals.rightsScope: Europe and MENA licensed; Hansa retained U.S. rights and launch economics
deals.contingentDisplay: €5m upon EMA full-approval filing acceptance
deals.royalty: No ongoing royalty highlighted in disclosed €115m value
deals.economics: Regional monetization provided capital while preserving the pending U.S. launch opportunity.
deals.insight: Directly relevant retained-rights precedent: sell ex-U.S. markets to strengthen the balance sheet before a U.S. launch.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $35m development milestones
deals.therapyArea: Pulmonary hypertension and fibrotic lung disease
deals.rightsScope: United Therapeutics leads global development, regulatory and commercialization; MannKind supports formulation and supply
deals.economics: United Therapeutics plans to be the primary manufacturer; the program sits under the parties' existing worldwide agreement.
deals.insight: A successful legacy partnership can be extended to new molecules with program-specific funding, milestones and a simple royalty.

deals.guaranteedDisplay: $53 per share; approximately $6.7bn equity value ($5.7bn net of cash)
deals.contingentDisplay: No CVR disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Company and global pipeline rights
deals.economics: Accounted for as an asset acquisition because substantially all value was attributed to TERN-701.
deals.insight: A company form does not necessarily imply platform value: accounting and price can still center on one early clinical asset.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $350m regulatory milestones plus commercial royalties
deals.royalty: Additional royalties tied to commercial milestones
deals.rightsScope: 100% of Kashiv, its biosimilar portfolio and development/manufacturing capabilities
deals.economics: Amneal also funds Kashiv operations through closing; transaction announced and pending at the database cutoff.
deals.insight: Cash, buyer equity, regulatory milestones and post-close royalties can combine when a portfolio and operating platform transfer together.

deals.asset: Gamgertamig / OM336 and autoimmune T-cell engager platform
deals.rightsScope: Gilead holds worldwide commercial rights outside Keymed territories; Lakefront holds operating assets and co-develops
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $500m contingent milestones
deals.royalty: Lakefront receives 20%–23% of net sales; costs and acquisition consideration split 50:50
deals.economics: Operational assets and people moved to Lakefront; Gilead retained commercialization control and funded half the transaction.
deals.insight: A sophisticated separation of ownership, operating capability and commercial rights across two strategic partners.

deals.rightsScope: Worldwide development and commercial rights, including U.S. launch through Almatica
deals.contingentDisplay: Upfront and milestones total up to $95m
deals.economics: Milestones cover development, FDA approval and sales thresholds; buyer leads global commercialization.
deals.insight: A current, smaller-scale rare-neurology license with a clear $95m cap and double-digit back-end participation.

deals.contingentDisplay: Program economics not separately disclosed
deals.royalty: Shared program economics under the existing collaboration framework
deals.rightsScope: Added a hypoparathyroidism program to the parties' existing oral-peptide collaboration
deals.economics: The expansion reuses the existing operating and ownership structure for a second therapeutic program.
deals.insight: An expandable collaboration framework lowers contracting friction when partners identify adjacent programs.

deals.contingentDisplay: Not disclosed
deals.asset: Rare pediatric neurology and oncology portfolio
deals.rightsScope: Company, products and pipeline rights
deals.economics: Financial terms were not disclosed; the transaction broadened Orphalan beyond rare liver disease.
deals.insight: A private portfolio acquisition can indicate strategic appetite even when price and contingent terms remain confidential.

deals.rightsScope: Company, U.S. product rights and commercial organization
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $165.7m CVR for idiopathic-hypersomnia approval
deals.royalty: 3.85% narcolepsy royalty and approximately 10% for future indications to Jazz through 2036
deals.economics: Buyer used about $775m cash and $1.525bn term debt; acquired a scaled specialty sales organization.
deals.insight: Around 8x 2025 sales before the CVR, with material third-party royalties—evidence that net economics matter more than headline revenue.

deals.contingentDisplay: No CVR disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Company and global product rights
deals.economics: The price was paid for a late-stage antiviral platform centered on a single Phase 3 prevention asset.
deals.insight: A pivotal, broadly addressable prevention asset can command acquisition economics well above typical specialty licenses.

deals.contingentDisplay: Development and sales milestones; amounts undisclosed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide rights to develop and commercialize defined enzyme-replacement therapies using Aliada's platform
deals.economics: Chiesi funds all research, development and commercialization worldwide.
deals.insight: A research collaboration can convert into a royalty-bearing exclusive license after preclinical platform validation.

deals.contingentDisplay: $1m operating condition + $3m at $10m sales + $3m at $15m sales
deals.rightsScope: Product and related commercial assets
deals.economics: Included supply and consulting conditions around transition.
deals.insight: A small non-core marketed brand can be divested for modest cash with most value tied to buyer-executed sales growth.

deals.contingentDisplay: Revenue earn-out through patent expiry in 2043
deals.royalty: 12% of U.S. AMELUZ revenue up to $65m annually; 15% above $65m
deals.rightsScope: All U.S. product, NDA/IND, IP, manufacturing and commercial assets and associated liabilities
deals.economics: Biofrontera assumed the U.S. operations, liabilities, legal defense and specified personnel; seller retained ex-U.S. rights.
deals.insight: A distressed related-party carve-out used equity and a long revenue share instead of cash to transfer the full U.S. franchise.

deals.guaranteedDisplay: $5.35 per share cash; approximately $303m equity value
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $1.00 per share CVR; approximately $57m
deals.rightsScope: Company and U.S. commercial franchise rights
deals.economics: The commercial product, field infrastructure and pending autoinjector extension transferred together.
deals.insight: A commercial-stage bolt-on used a modest CVR to isolate near-term regulatory upside from the base operating value.

deals.guaranteedDisplay: Up to $115m upfront and near-term payments
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $2bn development, regulatory and commercial milestones
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide ABO-101 rights plus options on additional rare-disease targets
deals.economics: The parties collaborate on the ongoing Phase 1/2 study; separate options cover additional platform programs.
deals.insight: A lead-asset license plus platform options creates immediate strategic access without pricing every future target upfront.

deals.rightsScope: Company, U.S. acute-care portfolio and commercial organization
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $25m REZZAYO regulatory milestone
deals.economics: Cash funded with balance-sheet cash and $150m convertible debt; milestone may be paid in cash or stock.
deals.insight: A strong infrastructure-acquisition comp: buyer paid for hospital call points, a portfolio and a functioning commercial team.

deals.contingentDisplay: Development, regulatory and commercial milestones; amounts undisclosed
deals.royalty: Single-digit deferred contingent payments and commercial milestones on sales
deals.rightsScope: Chiesi option to acquire all rights to products identified through the collaboration
deals.economics: Chiesi funds discovery, development and worldwide commercialization after option exercise.
deals.insight: An option structure delays the full license decision until hit finding and early lead work reduce discovery risk.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global product rights
deals.contingentDisplay: No acquisition CVR disclosed
deals.economics: $107 per ADS; buyer expected the transaction to become non-GAAP EPS accretive after initial launch investment.
deals.insight: A strategic-scale comp for a first-in-class launch asset; not directly comparable to a small commercial carve-out.

deals.contingentDisplay: Future sales milestones reduced in exchange for the larger near-term payment
deals.royalty: Tiered royalties reduced under the amendment; rates undisclosed
deals.rightsScope: Existing exclusive Greater China development and commercialization rights
deals.economics: The parties repriced future economics after approval to accelerate cash to Idorsia.
deals.insight: A post-approval amendment can trade long-dated milestones and royalty rate for greater near-term certainty.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global portfolio, subject to existing regional licenses
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $400m CVR for BLU-808 development and approval milestones
deals.economics: $129 per share cash plus $2 and $4 CVR payments for separate milestones.
deals.insight: Large platform and pipeline value drove a very high sales multiple; the CVR isolated early-pipeline uncertainty.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global asset rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Approximately $900m CVR tied to regulatory approval
deals.economics: $7 per share cash plus another $7 per share upon a specified approval milestone.
deals.insight: A 50/50 guaranteed-contingent split bridged early clinical risk while preserving large value for approval success.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to approximately $955m additional development, regulatory and sales milestones
deals.royalty: Tiered royalties on net sales; rates undisclosed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide development, manufacturing and commercialization rights
deals.economics: Novo Nordisk assumed global development; the headline includes the upfront and all potential milestones.
deals.insight: A validated buyer and competitive obesity market supported a $1bn headline for a preclinical discovery-program asset.

deals.contingentDisplay: $92.5m development + $177.5m regulatory + up to $1.5bn sales milestones
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide rights excluding Greater China
deals.economics: Hengrui retained Greater China; Merck assumed development and commercialization in the licensed territory.
deals.insight: A Phase 2 cardiometabolic license preserved the originator's home market while heavily weighting value to commercial performance.

deals.contingentDisplay: No conventional milestones disclosed
deals.royalty: 60% OPKO / 40% Entera ownership and cost share
deals.rightsScope: Joint program ownership and worldwide development framework
deals.economics: OPKO contributes peptide expertise; Entera contributes oral-delivery technology. Costs and value are shared 60/40.
deals.insight: Joint ownership can replace license economics when both parties contribute core technology and share early development risk.

deals.rightsScope: Stoke retained U.S., Canada and Mexico; Biogen received exclusive rest-of-world rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $385m development and commercial milestones
deals.royalty: Royalties on rest-of-world sales; rate undisclosed
deals.economics: Development costs are shared; Stoke preserves the core North American commercialization opportunity.
deals.insight: Regional separation can finance development while reserving the market the seller is best positioned to launch.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide development, manufacturing and commercial rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $35m regulatory and commercial milestones
deals.economics: Seller transferred a registration-ready biologic and existing drug supply; agreement included customary reversion rights.
deals.insight: Highly relevant small-cap benchmark for a late-stage specialty biologic with modest upfront and simple double-digit royalty.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $1.9bn development, regulatory and commercial milestones
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive global development, manufacturing and commercialization; conditional China co-promotion or commercialization rights for Hansoh
deals.economics: Merck assumed global development of a preclinical oral small molecule.
deals.insight: Even at preclinical stage, a competitive modality can command nine-figure upfront value with most consideration back-ended.

deals.contingentDisplay: No additional purchase price disclosed
deals.royalty: Buyer receives the stream to a capped return; residual economics revert to Idorsia
deals.rightsScope: Specified future vamorolone royalties and milestones until an agreed return cap, then economics revert to Idorsia
deals.economics: Monetized non-core economics without transferring development or commercial control.
deals.insight: A capped royalty sale creates immediate liquidity while retaining long-duration upside after the investor's return threshold.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive global rights; seller retained 40% of U.S. profits and losses
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $1.9bn development, regulatory and sales milestones
deals.royalty: Tiered double-digit royalties on ex-U.S. sales; 40% U.S. profit share
deals.economics: Buyer assumed global development and commercialization; seller kept meaningful U.S. participation.
deals.insight: A premium co-development structure for a high-value specialty asset where the seller prioritizes both liquidity and U.S. upside.

deals.contingentDisplay: $300m technology transfer + up to $140m development, $860m regulatory and $1.4bn sales milestones
deals.royalty: Royalties not separately disclosed in Merck's transaction summary
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide development, manufacturing and commercialization rights
deals.economics: The $300m technology-transfer payment was made after completion in July 2025.
deals.insight: Technical transfer can be a separately priced near-term gate between upfront consideration and long-dated milestones.

deals.rightsScope: Worldwide revenue participation; company retained product ownership and control
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $79m additional funding, including an approval-timing option
deals.economics: Included a time-limited change-of-control buyback option and stepped-down rates at higher sales.
deals.insight: Shows how a launch can be financed without selling rights, while capping dilution of economics as the asset outperforms.

deals.contingentDisplay: Regulatory and sales milestones; amounts undisclosed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive rights outside the U.S. and Europe; Lexicon retained U.S. and European rights
deals.economics: Lexicon supplies product at a transfer price while Viatris manages the licensed territories.
deals.insight: A geographically segmented license can add upfront liquidity without changing control of the core U.S. candidate asset.

deals.contingentDisplay: Commercial and supply economics not separately disclosed
deals.structure: Development, supply and regional license collaboration
deals.rightsScope: Amneal preferred U.S./EU supplier and licensee in selected emerging markets
deals.economics: Amneal expects $150m–$200m net capital investment over four to five years in peptide and fill-finish capacity, with Metsera contributing to buildout.
deals.insight: Manufacturing capacity and regional rights can substitute for cash consideration in a strategically integrated partnership.

deals.rightsScope: Dermavant equity and U.S. product economics
deals.contingentDisplay: $75m approval + up to $950m commercial milestones
deals.royalty: Tiered royalties on net sales; rates undisclosed
deals.economics: Buyer also assumed liabilities, including certain debt; most headline value depended on commercial scale.
deals.insight: A clear precedent for minimizing upfront cash while paying aggressively only if a growth-stage brand reaches major sales tiers.

deals.contingentDisplay: $0.5m IND + $0.25m NDA filing + $0.5m approval milestones
deals.royalty: 10% of certain asset transaction proceeds, including licenses up to a $20m payment cap and a potential priority-review-voucher sale
deals.rightsScope: All patents, know-how and related assets for P5P analogues
deals.economics: Consideration is highly back-ended and tied to both clinical progress and any downstream monetization.
deals.insight: Early intellectual property can be acquired for little cash with seller participation reserved for development and strategic exits.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $600m development and regulatory milestones
deals.rightsScope: Full global rights to the investigational CD3×CD19 bispecific antibody
deals.economics: Merck acquired the asset rather than the company and assumed global development.
deals.insight: A clean asset acquisition can deliver company-scale economics without acquiring the seller's platform or corporate overhead.

deals.rightsScope: Company and product rights
deals.contingentDisplay: No CVR disclosed
deals.economics: $7.15 per share cash; 2024 COSELA guidance at signing was $60m–$70m.
deals.insight: Demonstrates a premium for a differentiated hospital/oncology product despite modest current revenue and specialized execution needs.

deals.contingentDisplay: $150m contingent payment tied to specified conditions
deals.royalty: Shared profits outside Japan; Daiichi receives a Japan-sales royalty
deals.rightsScope: Global cost and profit share except Japan; Merck retained sole Japan rights and pays Daiichi a royalty
deals.economics: Expanded the parties' prior three-ADC alliance to include a Merck-originated asset.
deals.insight: A reciprocal portfolio relationship can shift one partner from licensor to co-investor as assets move in both directions.

deals.rightsScope: Company, global asset rights and discovery platform
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $325m development and regulatory milestones
deals.economics: Milestones covered future programs as well as progress of the lead PKU asset.
deals.insight: Platform value can materially increase price beyond the lead asset when the buyer wants repeatable specialty-product creation.

deals.rightsScope: Company and product rights
deals.contingentDisplay: $25m 2025 net-revenue milestone
deals.economics: Funded with $200m cash and new secured debt; expected immediately EBITDA-accretive.
deals.insight: A practical marketed-product comp near 5x expected sales, with a small earn-out tied to immediate commercial execution.

deals.rightsScope: Global ownership ex-Canada, including U.S. commercial rights
deals.guaranteedDisplay: Approximately $250m upfront cash including royalty obligations
deals.contingentDisplay: No earn-out disclosed
deals.royalty: Royalty obligations included in stated deal value
deals.economics: Acquired the company, brand and a lean commercial platform after 2023 U.S. gross sales exceeded $200m.
deals.insight: A direct platform-fit benchmark: roughly 1.25x disclosed gross sales for an established brand aligned to existing pain call points.

deals.rightsScope: Company, U.S. commercial infrastructure and international product rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $0.50 per share CVR tied to 2026–2027 revenue
deals.economics: $5.50 per share cash plus revenue CVRs; buyer also repaid $72.5m of debt.
deals.insight: Revenue-based CVRs bridged disagreement over growth while the buyer underwrote a clear ophthalmology call-point overlap.

deals.guaranteedDisplay: Primarily non-cash; consideration described as immaterial
deals.contingentDisplay: Not disclosed
deals.asset: iSPERSE formulation technology and Cricket inhaler cross-license
deals.rightsScope: MannKind licensed iSPERSE for defined indications and licensed its Cricket inhaler to Pulmatrix for inhaled DHE
deals.economics: MannKind hired selected R&D staff and assumed a Boston-area facility lease.
deals.insight: Technology, people and facilities can be exchanged together when the strategic objective is capability acquisition rather than a single asset.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $1.7bn development, regulatory and commercial milestones
deals.rightsScope: Company and global pipeline rights
deals.economics: The earn-out preserved upside for sellers while reducing Merck's cash at risk before key clinical and commercial events.
deals.insight: A company acquisition can be structured like an asset license when a large share of value sits behind milestones.

deals.rightsScope: Agios' royalty on U.S. net sales; Servier retained product rights
deals.contingentDisplay: No additional fixed milestones in the royalty sale
deals.royalty: Buyer receives 15% on U.S. sales to $1bn and 12% above $1bn; Agios retains 3% above $1bn
deals.economics: Closing/payment was contingent on FDA approval, aligning the financier with binary regulatory risk.
deals.insight: A useful valuation anchor for a high-confidence, near-launch U.S. royalty without transferring product control.

deals.rightsScope: Sanofi received ex-U.S. rights; Fulcrum retained U.S. commercialization and manufacturing
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $975m regulatory and sales milestones
deals.royalty: Low-teens to mid-20s on ex-U.S. sales
deals.economics: Future global development costs were shared 50:50; seller supplied product until a manufacturing transfer.
deals.insight: Important downside case: a large headline value can disappear after clinical failure; termination and reversion language matters.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $146m regulatory and $180m sales milestones
deals.royalty: Gossamer receives mid- to high-teens royalties ex-U.S.; 50/50 U.S. profits
deals.rightsScope: 50/50 U.S. development cost and profit share; Chiesi exclusive ex-U.S. rights
deals.economics: Global development costs are shared; the parties jointly commercialize in the U.S.
deals.insight: A late-stage co-development structure reduces one party's funding burden while preserving a domestic profit share.

deals.contingentDisplay: Development payments; amounts undisclosed
deals.asset: XeriSol glucagon for a bi-hormonal pump
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide pump and pump-system use
deals.economics: Beta Bionics leads pump-system development; Xeris provides the liquid-stable glucagon formulation.
deals.insight: A field-of-use license preserves the platform owner's freedom outside the defined device channel.

deals.guaranteedDisplay: $350m upfront; Idorsia initially committed $200m to development
deals.contingentDisplay: Milestones reduced by $250m in 2025 in exchange for a $100m lower development contribution
deals.royalty: Mid-single- to low-double-digit royalties; unchanged in the 2025 amendment
deals.rightsScope: Global rights with joint development; Viatris leads commercialization and expanded cenerimod territories in 2025
deals.economics: The 2025 amendment exchanged future milestones and territory for near-term cash relief.
deals.insight: Gross upfront can overstate net liquidity when the licensor simultaneously commits major development funding.

deals.contingentDisplay: Not disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive development and commercialization rights in the EU, UK and Switzerland
deals.economics: Zambon assumed regulatory and commercial responsibility in the licensed territory; financial terms were not disclosed.
deals.insight: Amneal retained its U.S. launch economics while using regional partners to fund and execute ex-U.S. expansion.

deals.rightsScope: U.S. research, development, manufacturing and commercial rights
deals.guaranteedDisplay: $15m purchase price, paid at first sale and after transition
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $97.5m commercial + $5m regulatory milestones
deals.royalty: Tiered 10%–30% on annual U.S. net sales
deals.economics: Included U.S. IP, regulatory and commercial data, product and transition activities.
deals.insight: The low entry price was offset by a rich royalty; strong precedent for conserving cash on a smaller marketed brand.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global asset rights
deals.contingentDisplay: No acquisition CVR disclosed
deals.economics: $32.50 per share cash before FDA decision; buyer absorbed approval risk.
deals.insight: Shows the value of a near-approval specialty asset that directly fits an existing liver-disease franchise.

deals.rightsScope: Worldwide license; 50:50 U.S. profit/loss share with seller opt-out rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $975m development, regulatory and commercial milestones if full opt-out
deals.royalty: Tiered ex-U.S. royalties; 50:50 U.S. economics while seller remains opted in
deals.economics: Buyer books global sales; seller can trade U.S. profit share for milestone and royalty economics.
deals.insight: A flexible model for retaining U.S. upside while outsourcing launch execution and preserving a later opt-out decision.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $75m development and regulatory milestones plus sales milestones
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive worldwide license to use XeriJect with teprotumumab
deals.economics: Amgen controls clinical development and commercialization; Xeris supplies formulation know-how.
deals.insight: A delivery-platform license can trade a modest disclosed back end for validation by an established commercial product owner.

deals.contingentDisplay: No CVR disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Company and global pipeline rights
deals.economics: $23 per share in cash; value centered on the Phase 1 DLL3 T-cell engager platform.
deals.insight: An early clinical company acquisition bundled the lead asset, discovery platform and talent into one fixed cash price.

deals.contingentDisplay: $50m at a $1.9bn sales trigger by 2026, or $45m at a $2.3bn trigger by 2027
deals.royalty: Sold 1% of net-sales royalties; retained approximately 9% under the United Therapeutics agreement
deals.rightsScope: Purchase of a 1% net-sales royalty through 2042; MannKind retained the remaining royalty stream
deals.economics: Non-dilutive financing against one slice of an established royalty stream.
deals.insight: Royalty sales can fund growth without transferring the product or surrendering the majority of future economics.

deals.contingentDisplay: No acquisition milestones disclosed
deals.rightsScope: U.S. and Canadian marketing and sale rights with related IP, regulatory records and contracts
deals.economics: Vanda assumed specified post-closing liabilities; seller retained pre-closing liabilities.
deals.insight: A clean marketed-asset transfer with no disclosed back end provides a useful cash-at-close precedent.

deals.contingentDisplay: Not disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive U.S. marketing and distribution rights
deals.economics: Amneal assumed U.S. commercial responsibility from December 18, 2023; financial terms were not disclosed.
deals.insight: Shows Amneal adding a marketed neurology asset adjacent to its specialty commercial platform.

deals.contingentDisplay: Development, regulatory and commercial milestones; amounts undisclosed
deals.royalty: Royalties on product sales; rate undisclosed
deals.rightsScope: Development, manufacturing and commercialization outside Greater China
deals.economics: The parties collaborate on development; Chiesi controls the licensed territory.
deals.insight: A conventional mid-stage ex-China license with undisclosed economics but clear territorial and operating allocation.

deals.rightsScope: U.S. and Japan development, manufacturing and commercial rights; Pfizer retained other territories
deals.contingentDisplay: $150m near-term Phase 3 milestone
deals.economics: Acquisition of Telavant transferred the regional asset vehicle and full development control for the covered territories.
deals.insight: A high-value example of using a dedicated entity to carve regional rights cleanly from a broader global asset.

deals.contingentDisplay: $1.5bn continuation payments plus up to $16.5bn sales milestones
deals.royalty: 50/50 profits outside Japan; Merck receives a Japan-sales royalty
deals.rightsScope: Global 50/50 cost and profit share except Japan; Daiichi retained sole Japan commercialization with royalty to Merck
deals.economics: Part of the upfront was refundable if programs were discontinued; R&D costs and commercialization are shared by asset and territory.
deals.insight: A portfolio alliance uses a large upfront, program continuation gates and profit sharing to divide multi-asset platform risk.

deals.rightsScope: Portion of PTC's worldwide royalty stream; product rights stayed with Roche
deals.contingentDisplay: Seller option to monetize the remaining royalty in tranches for up to $500m
deals.royalty: Royalty Pharma's share increased to about 81% of PTC's total royalty until a return threshold, then 66.7%
deals.economics: Non-dilutive liquidity backed by an approved global product; no transfer of development or commercial control.
deals.insight: Illustrates the value of separating a durable royalty from asset ownership when balance-sheet liquidity is the goal.

deals.contingentDisplay: Capped at CHF 306m through transaction proceeds and product royalties
deals.royalty: 30% of aprocitentan out-license/divestment proceeds; 10% of certain other product transactions; low-to-mid-single-digit group-sales royalty after approval
deals.rightsScope: Idorsia regained global development and commercialization rights; Janssen retained pulmonary-hypertension field rights
deals.economics: Consideration was tied to future monetization rather than cash at signing.
deals.insight: A reversion structure preserved cash while giving the former partner participation in later strategic value.

deals.contingentDisplay: $45m remaining milestones retained under the amended relationship
deals.royalty: Prior Japan royalty and a $10m sales milestone were removed
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive development and commercialization rights across South Korea and specified Asian markets
deals.economics: Maruho also assumed specified payment obligations owed to Dermira.
deals.insight: Regional rights can monetize a marketed brand while simplifying legacy royalty obligations.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive U.S. distribution and commercialization rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $4m development + $80m sales milestones
deals.royalty: Additional royalties / consideration; rate not publicly specified
deals.economics: Low upfront protected buyer capital; most consideration depended on approval and sales.
deals.insight: Relevant lower-end precedent for a single U.S. specialty asset when the seller accepts milestone-heavy value.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global portfolio rights
deals.contingentDisplay: No acquisition CVR disclosed
deals.economics: $172.50 per share in cash; financed with cash and term debt.
deals.insight: Shows the premium placed on a newly approved, first-in-disease rare-neurology product with global expansion potential.

deals.contingentDisplay: CHF 3m and CHF 7m option fees for cenerimod and lucerastat
deals.royalty: High-single-digit royalties on optioned products in the territory
deals.rightsScope: Asia-Pacific ex-China operations; PIVLAZ assignment; co-exclusive daridorexant rights; options on cenerimod and lucerastat
deals.economics: Included the Japan and South Korea affiliates and assigned future Mochida daridorexant milestones.
deals.insight: A regional carve-out can combine infrastructure, marketed rights and pipeline options in one strategic package.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive U.S., Canada and Mexico rights; first negotiation for Europe and Japan
deals.contingentDisplay: $36m approval milestone + up to $105m sales milestones
deals.royalty: Up to low-teens royalties; buyer assumed certain third-party royalties
deals.economics: North American license, manufacturing and supply arrangements; approved four months after signing.
deals.insight: A strong small-company template: meaningful upfront, equity alignment, approval payment, sales earn-out and ongoing royalty.

deals.contingentDisplay: No CVR disclosed
deals.rightsScope: Company and global pipeline rights
deals.economics: $200 per share in cash; value concentrated in the lead Phase 2 immunology asset.
deals.insight: A high-conviction Phase 2 acquisition can price in platform value and a large future commercial market before pivotal data.

deals.contingentDisplay: Preclinical milestones and option economics; amounts undisclosed
deals.asset: Two undisclosed monoclonal antibodies using XeriJect
deals.rightsScope: Regeneron options to license XeriJect formulations for two antibodies and potentially additional molecules
deals.economics: Xeris performs formulation work; Regeneron can exercise program-specific commercial licenses.
deals.insight: An option-to-license model lets a platform owner monetize formulation work before asset selection is complete.

deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $872.5m development, regulatory and sales milestones at signing
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive global rights; ModeX and Merck collaborate through IND, then Merck leads development and commercialization
deals.economics: Some proceeds are payable to Sanofi under ModeX's underlying antigen rights.
deals.insight: A preclinical vaccine can carry a large headline while most value remains contingent on long development and commercial milestones.

deals.rightsScope: Exclusive U.S. commercial rights; Eisai retained ex-U.S. rights
deals.contingentDisplay: $25m patent-extension milestone; post-exclusivity royalties
deals.royalty: Royalties after loss of patent exclusivity; rate undisclosed
deals.economics: Included regulatory records, IP, inventory, transition services and a seven-year supply agreement.
deals.insight: Clean example of buying a profitable U.S. brand near patent expiry with supply continuity and most value paid upfront.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global asset rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $3.50 per share CVR tied to sales thresholds
deals.economics: $8 per share cash; CVR milestones referenced $100m and $500m rolling annual sales thresholds.
deals.insight: Late-stage regulatory risk stayed with the buyer, while commercial outperformance was shared through sales CVRs.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global portfolio rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Approximately $244m CVR tied to biliary-atresia approval
deals.economics: $42 per share plus a $10 per share non-transferable CVR.
deals.insight: Regulatory upside was isolated in a CVR while the approved rare-disease franchise supported the base price.

deals.rightsScope: Company and global portfolio rights
deals.contingentDisplay: Up to $225m CVR tied to Filsuvez milestones
deals.economics: $14.50 per ADS cash plus up to $2.50 per ADS through non-tradeable CVRs.
deals.insight: A rare-disease platform premium was paid for multiple marketed assets, infrastructure and a regulatory catalyst.

deals.asset: ANNOVERA, IMVEXXY, BIJUVA and prenatal brands
deals.rightsScope: Exclusive U.S. commercialization rights plus operating assets
deals.contingentDisplay: $30m sales milestones
deals.royalty: 8% on first $80m annual sales; 7.5% above; 20-year term with minimums
deals.economics: Minimum royalties of $3m annually for 12 years, inflation-adjusted; buyer assumed development, regulatory, manufacturing and commercialization.
deals.insight: Useful precedent for transferring an operating portfolio while retaining a long-duration royalty and minimum-payment floor.
